Context: 3. Applications for appointment in PSUs.-

The relieving order should indicate the period within which the official should join the Public Sector Undertaking/ Autonomous Body. Normally this period should not be more than 15 days. This period may be extended by the competent authority for reasons beyond the control of the official. Necessary notification/orders accepting the resignation of the Government servant from Government service should be issued from the actual date of his/her joining the Public Sector Undertaking/ Autonomous Body.
